svg.text: Python 3.13 · the agent holds no credentials, only the gate · every tool call runs ten stages · rules decide, AI can only tighten · fail closed
tollgate.Gate: the only API the agent gets
user_message(text) · model_call(chat) · call_tool(name, args, provider, token)
Action lane: call_tool() runs ten stages in order; the strictest finding wins
NFKC, strip zero-width characters, compact IBAN spellings
decode base64 so the scanners see hidden data
verify the HMAC-SHA256 agent token (claims in the excerpt below)
impersonation, tool scope, amount scope, delegation depth
signed feed patterns on arguments (CVE-based), 12 secret formats
loop guard: 3rd identical call with no state change is blocked
look up invoice, vendor and payments (read-only): the Effect
run the contract's checks: present, equals, same_iban, at_most …
SQLite authorizer: deny table, blank column, row-scope views
reserve the amount in a time window in state.db
sees only the user's words and verified facts; answers in JSON
its quote must appear verbatim in a user turn, else ask
ask goes to the approval queue
bind verified values (amount and IBAN from the records)
BEGIN IMMEDIATE · re-check the contract · run · COMMIT
mask IBANs and IDs, redact secrets, tokenize for Gemini
hidden orders: rules first, models only on unclear sentences
append a JSONL record with the sha256 of the previous one
update Prometheus counters; push the event to the dashboard
Gemini via the privacy vault · Ollama locally
Gemini or qwen3:8b, JSON schema, 45 s timeout
ERP writes · email · model files · MCP upstreams
qwen3:0.6b screens unclear text · qwen3:8b confirms
type: same_iban # agent's IBAN vs the record
# delegation can only narrow tools and max_eur
